claim: Cochlear implants become widespread two-way network interfaces
originalWording: Cochlear implants become widespread two-way network interfaces

sources.title: The Age of Spiritual Machines — Ray Kurzweil (1999)
sources.locator: Computers and communications in 2029: cochlear implants

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source on Sources for attribution limits.

strict.criterion: Cochlear-style implants are widely used beyond hearing impairment as two-way interfaces to a computing network.
strict.rationale: The 2029 deadline remains future. Therapeutic cochlear implants establish only a portion of the predicted technology and population. They are not yet a general network interface for ordinary users.

evidence.title: What educators need to know about cochlear implants — FDA
evidence.note: Cochlear implants do not restore normal hearing. Used to correct a medical error in our intake, not to manufacture a Kurzweil forecast.
